adjudicator_owned.role: separate bounded adjudicator for the nfo_identity canonical fixture
adjudicator_owned.product_checkout_only: Authoring performed only inside the current product checkout. No path outside the checkout was read or written.
adjudicator_owned.no_execution: No tests, cargo, builds, corpus runs, provider calls, network calls, or git operations were performed. This file declares required predicates and expected values; it records no observation as having been observed.
adjudicator_owned.owner: This file is adjudicator-owned. It is not an author artifact and never preclaims that any run already passed.
adjudicator_owned.declaration: Every required predicate below is derived only from the author-owned input bytes, the author manifest (route model, identity-claim topology, hashes), and product source symbols consulted read-only. Author inputs were used as read-only and were not invented, rewritten, or extended.

scope.synthetic_notice: All corpus content is original synthetic GPL-3.0-only material. Identifier blocks (TMDB 9200001-9200008/9300005-9300006, IMDb tt9200001-tt9200008/tt9300005-tt9300006, TVDB 8200001-8200008/8300005-8300006) are fictional reserved blocks, not real provider records.
scope.author_separation: Author-owned artifacts are xml/*, provider/*, manifest.json, README.md, PROVENANCE.md. The author withheld expected.json and all verdicts. This file supplies the withheld verdict contract and touches no author artifact.

integrity.note: Read-only snapshot taken at adjudication time. Hashes below were observed, not authored by the corpus author, and are recorded here for change detection only. XML and provider byte hashes are not repeated here; the author manifest.json and PROVENANCE.md already record them, and each record below references those recorded hashes as expected values.

record_contract.record_counting_rule: The harness MUST report exactly the eight records above. NFO-08 is ONE movie family recorded as one record whose phases (initial-malformed, corrected-body, manual-assign) are states inside that single record. Phases are never extra records.

harness_verdict_levels.required: must_observe: the referenced observation slot must exist and satisfy the predicate, else FAIL.
harness_verdict_levels.prohibited: must_not_observe: the referenced observation must be absent/false, else FAIL.
harness_verdict_levels.blocked_or_inconclusive: stop condition: if the referenced state is observed (or cannot be produced), the harness MUST return BLOCKED or INCONCLUSIVE for the case, never PASS. A PASS requires every required predicate to hold, every prohibited predicate to be false, and no stop condition to fire.

op.present: field is present and not null
op.in: field is one of the expected array values
op.not_in: field is none of the expected array values
op.includes: string or array includes the expected value
op.includes_all: array includes every member of the expected array
op.all_in: every element of the field array is a member of the expected array
op.starts_with: string starts with the expected prefix

field_prefixes.input: per-file NFO input facts: bytes, sha256, body_state, parse outcome, parsed identity fields
field_prefixes.item: per-item pipeline state after the stage: metadata status, reason, links, keys, binding
field_prefixes.trace: provider request trace with one entry per request, each mapped to a manifest route_id

glossary.body_state: Classification of the NFO byte payload. Values: present (well-formed XML root with content), malformed (bytes fail parse), absent (zero bytes). A zero-byte file is absent, never parsed.
glossary.body_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact NFO input bytes; must equal the hash the author recorded for that file.
glossary.origin: Source of a parsed claim. Values: nfo (claim came from the NFO bytes), location (derived from folder/media path only), provider, none.
glossary.parsed.ids: { tmdb, imdb, tvdb } parsed from the NFO. null when the NFO carries no such id.
glossary.parsed.content: { plot_present, genre_present, cast_present, plot, genres[], cast_names[] }. Meaningful means non-empty beyond structure, not a stub.
glossary.metadata_status: Observed item status string. Values follow product MetadataStatus: pending, matched, ready, unmatched.
glossary.manually_matched: 0 = automatic binding; 1 = manual Assign binding. Observed per item.
glossary.item_key: ADR-0025 watch-shaped key. item_links::path_item_key(library_id, relpath) == format!("path:{library_id}:{relpath}"). item_links::is_watch_item_key(key) is true for tmdb:movie:, tmdb:episode:, path:, tvdb: prefixes; tmdb:show: is NOT a watch key.
glossary.route_id_term: Manifest route identifier. Every traced request must map to a manifest route_id or be recorded as an unmapped simulated provider miss.
glossary.request_class: Manifest route class: identity, content, observability. identity = request the identity stage may issue; content = enrichment after identity binds; observability = inspection only, never an identity request.
glossary.provider_miss: A request with no mapped response file simulates a provider miss (product-equivalent of 404/Ok(None)). A real empty-results search body is NOT a miss file; it is a hit that returns zero results.
glossary.capability.state: Identity-stage capability/abstention for the case. Must be recorded with a machine reason, never replaced by prose.
glossary.find_crosscheck: /find external-id lookup plus /tv detail cross-check (product find_hit_reject_reason: name and folder-year must agree or the id is discarded and search runs instead).
glossary.trace_scoped_response: Response facts for one traced request are read under trace.request_with_route_id.<route_id>.response.* so a record with several provider responses keeps each route's facts distinct.
glossary.watch: Block-2 watch_state and playback_events tables. watch_state rows carry item_key and non-key values (position_ms, duration_ms, played, last_played_at). playback_events rows carry item_key and per-event non-key values. Migration rewrites item_key old -> destination and must preserve every non-key value.
glossary.harness_booleans: Harness-computed booleans. Each is true only when its row-level/derived condition holds: trace.any_identity_class_request, trace.identity_class_detail_request, find.find_route_observed, find.detail_route_observed, find.correct_binding_observed, find.reject_reason_recorded, item.bound_identity_wrong_key, merge.merge_observation_recorded, merge.merge_field_preserving, watch.seed.*, watch.before_snapshot_complete, watch.after_snapshot_complete, watch.snapshot_evidence, watch.destination_is_watch_key, watch.destination_rows_present, watch.old_key_present_after, watch.non_key_values_preserved, input.byte_identical_to_corrected_body, input.file_byte_difference_from_manual_assign.
